description: A renal services coordinator must assign the hospital's one portable continuous-renal-replacement machine for tonight between two ICU patients and finalize the treatment setup, timing, and infection-control arrangements, with input from nephrology, biomedical engineering, infection prevention, and dialysis staffing.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one portable continuous-renal-replacement machine available for overnight use.
shared_context.S2: Patients in ICU Rooms 8 and 12 are both being evaluated for the machine.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final equipment assignment and treatment-plan decision.
shared_context.S4: The routine renal-services huddle includes nephrology, biomedical engineering, infection prevention, and dialysis staffing before the overnight plan is finalized.

PF1.text: The patient in Room 8 has a potassium level of 6.7 mmol/L with new electrocardiographic changes and needs continuous renal replacement therapy started tonight; the patient in Room 12 can safely wait for scheduled intermittent dialysis tomorrow morning.

PF2.text: The available portable machine has already been fitted with the regional-citrate circuit, and Room 8's patient must receive regional citrate anticoagulation because of a documented heparin-induced thrombocytopenia history; the machine's current setup is not compatible with the standard heparin circuit.

PF3.text: Room 8 requires airborne precautions, so infection prevention requires the portable machine to be staged inside Room 8 by 20:30 and requires a dedicated equipment-barrier setup before treatment begins.

PF4.text: The only dialysis RN credentialed for this machine is available from 21:00 to 05:00, so the treatment must start at exactly 21:00 to fit the eight-hour overnight coverage window.

acceptance_conditions: The portable machine must be assigned to the patient in Room 8.
The treatment must use regional citrate anticoagulation.
The machine must be staged and set up in Room 8 by 20:30.
A dedicated equipment-barrier setup for Room 8 must be recorded as a commitment.
The nephrology finding supporting the assignment must be cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'dedicated_equipment_barrier' and c['target'] == 'Room 8' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The potassium of 6.7 mmol/L with new electrocardiographic changes makes Room 8 the patient who must receive the machine tonight instead of Room 12.
The heparin-induced thrombocytopenia history and the already fitted circuit change the anticoagulation choice to exactly regional citrate.
Room 8's airborne precautions change the setup deadline to exactly 20:30 and require the dedicated equipment-barrier commitment.
The credentialed dialysis RN's 21:00-to-05:00 availability fixes the treatment start at exactly 21:00.
